s: We leverage large internal datasets of RNAseq from key tissues known to be addressable with antisense, such as the CNS, eye, liver and kidney, that are purpose-built to enhance the capture of non-productive events. 9 We employ machine learning to iteratively refine our search and scoring criteria for the most a ddressable non-productive mRNA elements based on internal target validation and Hit identification data.
